verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI coding tool, but the evidence pack never documents self-hosting. Nothing shows an open-source license, running against local or self-hosted models, or operating without Google's hosted service. The pack points the other way: it describes signing in with a Google account and running in Google's Cloud Shell, so the core service stays Google-hosted. A local Node runtime requirement (comm-4) only shows the client installs locally, which is not the same as self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
